clips.title: The story
paras: In western Duskwood, Abercrombie sends travelers to the ogre stronghold at Vul'Gol Ogre Mound. He says the ogres ambushed him while he foraged and took a crate of irreplaceable herbs and tools.

Abercrombie, an aged hermit on the damp roads of western Duskwood, says he was attacked while gathering supplies. Brutes from the southern ogre mound drove him off, and he left behind a sturdy wooden crate packed with precious herbs and delicate instruments.
The Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies in southern Duskwood, where hostile ogres harass unwary wanderers. Abercrombie's crate rests right near the entrance, among roaring brutes and spell-weaving magi.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me! I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.
After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood. I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.
Please, friend, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my crate? If so, then please...give it to me quickly!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, friend! You have more than earned your reward.
